name: Sony BRAVIA 4K GB
summary: Turn off Samba TV viewing tracking, Sony promo rows and retail demo modes on the Sony BRAVIA 4K GB. Free phone app, with a backup first and one-tap undo.
intro: The Sony BRAVIA 4K GB ships with Samba TV, a viewing tracker that recognises what is on screen. It also has Sony Select, My BRAVIA promos and a Discover content bar, retail demo modes, and device agents that run in the background. Google recommendation rows and some preloaded apps are on as well.

The new home screen was set and held after a reboot. Chromecast, screen mirroring, the DLNA renderer, the phone remote and the USB media and music players are left on by choice. TidyTV turns the other apps off from a phone on the same Wi-Fi, after saving a backup, and nothing is uninstalled.
keep: The DLNA renderer and the Android TV phone remote
The USB media player and music player
Live TV and every HDMI input, which run through Sony's TV app
notes: A Sony service broadcasts the TV's model, MAC address and IP address on the home network. This list turns it off.
The notes say this list has not been used for weeks yet. If an app breaks, switch it back on in TidyTV.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Sony BRAVIA 4K GB?
faq.a: The list does not turn off Google Assistant or voice search, so the voice button should still work.
Yes. Chromecast built-in and screen mirroring are left on by choice.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns the apps back on and puts the old home screen back, in one tap.
